scope: New v3 engine/schema/policy; retain v1 and v2 policies and checkpoint restoration. Requests still name only outcome priorities, externalization preference and paid accessible content, never a route or recipe.
bundles: Share, Coordinate, Educate and Commune join their typed source to its exact paid offer and the exact receiver reply. Identify joins shared content to an owned stance. Mobilize consumes shared content. Institutionalize accumulation joins shared content to the complete bounded set of distinct supplied successful relevant member observations; expenditure joins an exact draft to one paid vote from each current member.
social_scope: Real paid scoped two-member group; actor and peer are exactly those members. Shared content and draft participants equal that set; every task assignee belongs to it. Exact source/offer/reply, sender/receiver, group and offered task joins are required. Offers and receiver-computed replies must already exist as paid native work; the selector cannot manufacture exchange or receipt. Missing exchange means deferred applicability.
authority: Mobilize needs authorized shared content. Its expenditure also needs paid stock, custody and an actually ready first care task. Native one-attempt allowance, stock, custody and revision checks remain authoritative. Institutionalization needs distinct actual events; a declined vote can produce a declined rule, never authority. Education produces understanding/assent records, no practiced skill.
v3_ordering: Retain highest outcome priority then matching externalization preference. Among those candidates prefer more distinct supplied input references consumed, then lower Model A plus material effort, cell, serialized inputs. This prospective bounded engineering tie-break favors accounting for supplied scope/practice over dropping those inputs to make a cheaper partial model. It is not a source law or optimal planning claim. The v1/v2 ordering is unchanged. Comparison extent remains 1 + supplied references + candidate cells + examined bundles.
controls: 32 matched choice-withholding controls: identical paid comparison, no child, changed fixed downstream output/custody question, ordinary auditor rejects. Child and downstream costs are separate. Scope/removal tests retain paid evidence and reject missing exchange/group or duplicate practice rather than synthesizing substitutes.
audit: Independent reconstruction from saved transactions and access receipts with separate joins, scheduling and rank; imports no selector or executor. Native audit validates the actual receiver work, immutable Fold intermediates, material spending and no skill from teaching.
